machine_role: anonymized development environment; not a target-device measurement
photos: Synthetic, openly licensed test images with neutral filenames and EXIF removed.

before_fix.cause: a separate extract call per photo stopped the warm model, so CLIP reloaded for every photo

heic_decode_memory_probe.method: Worker image preparation alone, peak RSS in a fresh Python process; baseline about 20 MB

limitations: Not measured on the DS220+. Unrelated queries still return ranked results; there is no no-match signal. A 24 MP HEIC was measured only for decode memory, not end to end in the container.
